guides.title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: imec iSiPP silicon-photonics platform: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: iSiPP 平台可用元件與服務版本需一致。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: iSiPP components must match the service/platform version. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：iSiPP 平台可用元件與服務版本需一致。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：查對官方元件清單、封裝介面及測試途徑。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: iSiPP components must match the service/platform version. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Check official component lists, packaging interfaces and test paths. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「查對官方元件清單、封裝介面及測試途徑」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check official component lists, packaging interfaces and test paths, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: imec iSiPP silicon-photonics platform: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「平台與晶圓尺寸：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。iSiPP200 與 iSiPP300 是不同平台，晶圓直徑不是唯一差異，也不能假設元件庫可直接互換。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Platform and wafer size: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 are distinct platforms; diameter is not their only difference and libraries are not interchangeable. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜平台與晶圓尺寸：模型與設計：將公開功能、接合選項與可取得設計套件分開列示並標日期。
觀察站 2｜轉印材料：模型與設計：比較加入元件前後的損耗、相位和電性能，避免只看功能是否出現。
觀察站 3｜設計釋出：量測與判別：交付可追溯 manifest、已知限制和回歸結果，不宣稱公開文件等於完整流片許可。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Platform and wafer size: model and design: Date a table of public capabilities, integration options and available design kits.
Observation station 2 | Transfer-printed materials: model and design: Compare loss, phase and electrical behavior before/after integration, not merely function presence.
Observation station 3 | Design release: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver a traceable manifest, known limits and regression results; public documentation is not fabrication authorization.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「轉印材料：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「設計釋出：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Transfer-printed materials: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Design release: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

Incorrect hypothesis to reject: iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.
